title: One Fungus Drove 90 Amphibian Species Extinct
hook: One fungus drove 90 amphibian species extinct.
closing: One pathogen reshaped amphibian survival worldwide, and recovery remains rare.
question: Which amphibian would you protect?

segments.say: The fungus drove 90 amphibian species extinct. One pathogen became a global extinction force.
About 39 percent of affected species are still declining. The damage continues long after detection.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. Isolation did not protect the ecosystem.
